meta.title: DeepSeek Harness app controls
meta.description: Adds check/update and quit buttons to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, plus a KDE system-tray controller and a settings panel in Plugins. Settings cover the tray icon, per-feature show/hide controls, and a remembered default startup window size; they are stored locally and applied on the next DSH start. The buttons check/update DSH with a progress dialog, or gracefully stop the service and close the window; the tray shows status and offers open, plugins, settings, update, restart, stop, logs and copy URL. Applicable to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.x Web profile on Linux/KDE (Chrome app window) and Node.js 20+; the tray needs PyQt5.
